# Map
```{r}
library(tmap)
# Set plot mode
tmap_mode("plot")
```
```{r}
map <- tm_shape(joinData) +
  tm_polygons(
    fill = "difference",
    fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
      style = "pretty",
      midpoint = 0,
      values = "-brewer.rd_bu",
      value.na = "grey85",
      label.na = "No data"
    ),
    fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "GII change\n(2019 - 2010)"),
    col = "white", lwd = 0.2
  ) +
  tm_title("Change in Gender Inequality Index, 2010–2019") +
  tm_layout(frame = FALSE, legend.outside = TRUE)

map
```
